agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: The agents in this Microsoft Foundry project. Creating and publishing versions happens here — no portal needed.
agents.emptyBody: An agent brings together instructions, tools and a knowledge base. Once you publish the first one, it shows up here with its version history.

login.note: Answers cite their source and respect each document's access. That is why we need to know who is asking.

console.sourcesEmpty: The sources an answer cites appear here — every claim grounded in the base, never assumed.
